college.name: Excel Engineering College
college.address: NH-544, Salem Main Road, Pallakkapalayam, Komarapalayam, Namakkal – 637303, Tamil Nadu

locations.name: Welcome Block
locations.description: Visitor reception, security, and the official starting point for campus walking routes.

locations.name: Temple & Mega Rain Water Harvest Tank
locations.description: Campus temple with the 2A mega rain-water harvest tank beside it.

steps: Enter via the Main Gate and stand at the Welcome Block.
Turn left (west) onto the front campus road.
Walk past the lawn; the temple and 2A rain-water tank are on your left near the boundary.

locations.name: Excel Public School – CBSE
locations.description: Excel Public School (CBSE) campus block for school students.

steps: Enter via the Main Gate at the Welcome Block.
Take the west service road along the front of campus.
Continue past the temple cluster; Excel Public School is on your left.

locations.name: Civil Department, EEC
locations.description: Civil Engineering block of Excel Engineering College.

steps: Enter via the Main Gate and pass the Welcome Block.
Turn right (east) on the front academic road.
Civil Department / EEC is on your right, close to the entrance boulevard.

locations.name: S&H, ECE Block
locations.description: Science & Humanities and Electronics & Communication Engineering block.

steps: Enter via the Main Gate at Welcome Block.
Walk east on the first inner road.
S&H and ECE Block is ahead on your left after Civil.

locations.name: Play Ground & Fitness Center
locations.landmark: Open field west of the main spine
locations.description: Sports ground and fitness center for students and staff.

steps: Enter via the Main Gate.
Walk straight past Welcome Block, then veer left toward the open field.
Play Ground & Fitness Center is on the west lawn.

locations.name: Boys Hostel II
locations.description: Boys Hostel II residential block.

steps: Enter via the Main Gate and walk north along the central avenue.
At the mid-campus crossroad, turn left (west).
Boys Hostel II is the first large residential block on the west side.

locations.name: Boys Hostel I & III
locations.description: Combined Boys Hostel I and III complex.

steps: Enter via Main Gate and follow the central avenue north.
Turn west at the Hyundai / mid-campus junction.
Continue past Boys Hostel II; Hostels I & III are further north on the same belt.

locations.name: Hyundai Professional Development Center
locations.description: Hyundai PDC for industry training and partner recruitment events.

steps: Enter via the Main Gate and walk straight along the central avenue.
Stop at the mid-campus crossroad.
Hyundai Professional Development Center is on your left.

locations.name: A, A4 – Mech & Aeronautical Departments
locations.landmark: Blocks A / A4 on the central belt
locations.description: Mechanical and Aeronautical Engineering departments (Blocks A & A4).

steps: Enter via Main Gate and walk north past Welcome Block.
Continue along the avenue toward the academic core.
Mech & Aeronautical (A / A4) is just west of the central road.

locations.name: Computer Science, CS & BS Departments
locations.description: Computer Science, CS, and BS department cluster.

steps: Enter via the Main Gate and walk north on the central avenue.
At the mid-campus junction, bear right.
Computer Science / CS & BS is on your right before the library plaza.

locations.name: 24×7 Central Library, IT, EEE, PCT
locations.landmark: Heart of campus on the main spine
locations.description: 24×7 Central Library with IT, EEE, and PCT departments in the same cluster.

steps: Enter via the Main Gate and walk through the Welcome Block.
Continue straight on the central avenue, past S&H / ECE on your right and the playground on your left.
Central Library (24×7) with IT, EEE and PCT is on the plaza — the library entrance faces you on the left of the walkway.

locations.name: Excel Nursing College, HR & Placement
locations.description: Nursing College sharing the block with HR and the Placement Cell.

steps: Enter via Main Gate and walk north to the mid-campus crossroad.
Turn right (east) toward the Nursing / Placement cluster.
Excel Nursing College with HR & Placement is on your right.

locations.name: Pink & Deluxe Girls Hostel
locations.description: Pink and Deluxe Girls Hostel complex.

steps: Enter via the Main Gate and follow the central avenue to mid-campus.
Turn east, pass Nursing / Placement on your right.
Continue to the far-east residential belt; Pink & Deluxe Girls Hostel is ahead.

locations.name: Excel Fusion Café
locations.description: Campus café for meals, snacks, and token orders.

steps: Enter via Main Gate and walk straight to the Central Library plaza.
From the library, take the short east path.
Excel Fusion Café is on your right, just north of the CSE cluster.

locations.name: A2 – ECCS Fashion, Viscom, Microbiology, Biochemistry
locations.description: Block A2: Fashion Costume Design, Visual Communication, Microbiology, and Biochemistry.

steps: Enter via Main Gate and walk north to the library plaza.
Turn east toward the A-blocks.
A2 (Fashion, Viscom, Microbiology, Biochemistry) is on the northeast academic row.

locations.name: A5 – Architecture College
locations.description: Excel College of Architecture & Planning (Block A5).

steps: Enter via Main Gate and stay on the central avenue all the way north.
At the north crossroad, turn right.
Architecture College (A5) is at the northeast corner of campus.

locations.name: A6 – College of Education
locations.description: Excel College of Education (Block A6).

steps: Enter via Main Gate and walk the full length of the central avenue.
Turn east on the north road.
College of Education (A6) is on your left before Architecture.

locations.name: B3, B5 – Polytechnic College
locations.description: Excel Polytechnic College blocks B3 and B5.

steps: Enter via Main Gate and walk north past Welcome Block, Mech/CSE, and the library.
Keep on the central avenue to the north end.
Polytechnic (B3, B5) is slightly to your right.

locations.name: Staff Quarters
locations.description: On-campus housing for faculty and staff.

steps: Enter via Main Gate and walk north to mid-campus.
Turn west, pass the boys hostels on your left.
Continue to the northwest corner; Staff Quarters are ahead.
